title: Research Data Series: Index of Common Inflation Expectations
summary: The Federal Reserve published a FEDS Note describing the Index of Common Inflation Expectations (CIE), a dynamic factor model that summarizes comovement across multiple inflation expectations measures. The note documents quarterly update procedures and April 2022 methodology changes including additions of NY Fed SCE and Michigan Survey percentile measures. No actual current inflation expectations data is provided - only the data framework.
key_points: CIE index projects onto SPF 10-year PCE inflation and Michigan next 5-10 year inflation measures using a dynamic factor model
April 2022 methodology update added NY Fed SCE 1-year and 3-year ahead measures and Michigan 25th/75th percentile expectations
TIPS-derived 5-year breakeven inflation removed as redundant with other included TIPS measures
Livingston Survey measure redefined to correspond to 12-month growth from survey month
Updated CIE assumes autoregressive process of order 5 for latent factor dynamics
Quarterly updates scheduled for third Friday of first month of each quarter at noon Eastern Time
